# WildestAI

> WildestAI turns code changes from raw diffs into understandable, evidence-linked software evolution.

## What it is

WildestAI is a developer tool that solves the **generation-verification gap**: AI coding tools have made code generation fast and cheap, but understanding, reviewing, and verifying what changed has become the new bottleneck.

The core problem: reading a diff is not the same as understanding a change. Understanding a change is not the same as verifying it should exist.

WildestAI helps developers, reviewers, and AI agents answer three questions every time code changes:
- **What changed?** — not just lines and files, but components, behaviour, APIs, and dependencies
- **Why did it change?** — intent, prompt, decision, constraint, alternatives considered
- **What is the impact?** — runtime behaviour, risk, test coverage, architectural drift, future agent context

## Products

### `wild` CLI (current)
A command-line tool that wraps `git` and provides AI-powered analysis on `wild diff`.

- Reads your current git diff (staged, unstaged, commit range, or specific files)
- Sends to an AI model for semantic analysis
- Generates a dependency graph as an HTML report
- Supports: `wild diff`, `wild diff --staged`, `wild diff <commit>`, `wild diff <file>`
- All other `wild <cmd>` commands pass through to `git` transparently
- Open source, free, no account required

Install: `pip install wildest-ai` (or clone from GitHub)
Usage: `wild diff` — generates `diffgraph.html` and opens it in your browser

### VS Code Extension (current)
Available on VS Code Marketplace and OpenVSX.
- Visualises AI-generated code changes inside VS Code
- Source Control-like sidebar showing changed components
- Click to navigate from graph node to exact code range

Links:
- VS Code Marketplace: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=WildestAI.wildest-vscode-ext
- OpenVSX: https://open-vsx.org/extension/WildestAI/wildest-vscode-ext

### Planned surfaces
- Vibinex / GitHub browser extension — code review overlay for PRs
- CI/CD integration — automated DiffGraph artifacts on PR open
- Enterprise / on-prem — compliance, audit, traceability

## Key concepts

**DiffGraph** — the core representation: a graph of changed components and their relationships, generated from a git diff. Shows logical structure (what changed and how components relate) rather than line-by-line text.

**Semantic diffing vs textual diffing** — a textual diff answers "which lines changed?"; a semantic diff answers "what changed in the system?". WildestAI moves from line-level to system-level understanding.

**Three loops**:
- Inner loop: local development — "what did this AI agent just do?"
- Middle loop: code review — "can another human responsibly approve this?"
- Outer loop: organisational memory — "how has the system evolved, and can we trust the process?"

**Evidence over vibes** — every claim links to code. "This changes token validation in auth.ts" not "this improves auth."
